name: San Antonio Express-News editorial board
lean_basis: Hearst paper; AllSides rates it Lean Left. In San Antonio-area races its 2026 picks are 19 Democrats and 5 Republicans (DA, a county court, the 4th Court of Appeals, CD-21 and HD-122). It opposed City Prop A and two SAISD bonds and backed the other school measures it reviewed. It says it recommends only in contested races with major-party candidates.

name: League of Women Voters of the San Antonio Area
lean_basis: Nonpartisan; its guide says it "does not support or oppose any political party or candidate." Prints candidates' own answers and lists arguments for and against City Prop A.

name: Republican Party of Bexar County
lean_basis: Official county party organization. Its candidate roster and two-page Conservative Voter Guide list only Republican nominees, plus picks in two nonpartisan appraisal board seats. Takes no stand on local propositions in either document.

name: Bexar County Democratic Party
lean_basis: Official county party organization. Its Lift the Slate site lists only Democratic nominees and no local propositions.

name: San Antonio AFL-CIO (Central Labor Council)
lean_basis: Regional labor council. Every candidate on its 2026 slate is a Democrat; it took "no action" in HD-122. Backs all SAISD, Northside ISD and South San ISD measures and took no position on City Prop A.

name: San Antonio Police Officers' Association PAC (SAPOA)
lean_basis: Police union PAC; picks cross party lines. In contested races it backs 9 Republicans (all its congressional, governor and lieutenant governor picks, three Texas House candidates and one county court candidate) and 5 Democrats. Most of its other Democratic picks are unopposed.
